sources.summary: The Mono awards celebrate the best black and white images chosen from more than 3,000 entries from Australia, New Zealand and around the world. This year’s category winners are Carly Goldsmith in people, Andy Zakeli in places and Brooke Pyke in animals. The full shortlists, including the top 30 images from each category, are featured in the latest issue of Australian Photography.
